classification_definitions.Native: A rule implementation exists in the pinned core; not an assertion of independent validation, engine strength or release approval.
classification_definitions.Adapted: Existing core/configuration or presentation mechanisms can cover part or all of the requested variant after specified adaptation and tests.
classification_definitions.New Rules: Additional rule/state/move code is required within a broadly two-player engine architecture.
classification_definitions.Special Architecture: A coordinator, multiplayer model, single-player solver or observation-only search is required beyond the current complete two-player position model.

extraction_limitations: C++ assignments are source expressions, not runtime rule introspection
Control flow, header defaults other than geometry, and conclude() are not evaluated
INI examples are neither loaded nor rule-validated by source extraction
Native/source registration, runtime inventory, validation, and release approval differ

requested_games.name: No Castling
requested_games.notes: Castling disabled in both rules and initial FEN.

requested_games.name: 3-Check
requested_games.notes: Check counters are part of state/FEN and terminal adjudication.

requested_games.name: N-Check
requested_games.notes: 3-check and 5-check exist. Other bounded counts need validated config/FEN handling; current FEN parser reads single-character counters. Arbitrary unbounded N is not supported.

requested_games.name: King of the Hill
requested_games.notes: Center flag-square victory exists; king safety and terminal fixtures remain separate evidence.

requested_games.name: Racing Kings
requested_games.notes: Race objective, no-check movement and response move are core rules.

requested_games.name: Horde
requested_games.notes: 36-pawn starting army and first/second-rank double steps exist; verify Chess.com edge cases independently.

requested_games.name: Atomic
requested_games.notes: Explosions and pseudo-royal king rules exist; no new NNUE or measured strength is implied.

requested_games.name: Crazyhouse
requested_games.notes: Single-board pocket/drop rules exist; promotion demotion and pawn-drop limits need targeted validation.

requested_games.name: Giveaway / Antichess
requested_games.notes: These IDs are different rulesets: FSF giveaway allows castling, antichess prohibits it. Chess.com Giveaway maps to antichess.

requested_games.notes: Pinned core rules exist; board dimensions, castling/gating/promotion and terminal rules require variant-specific tests.

requested_games.name: Janus Chess
requested_games.notes: Pinned core rules exist; board dimensions, castling/gating/promotion and terminal rules require variant-specific tests.

requested_games.name: Chess with Different Armies
requested_games.notes: Asymmetric pieces and configurable armies are expressible in part; exact army pairings, special castling and promotion rules are not a complete implemented game. Do not alias to Spartan or another asymmetric game.

requested_games.name: Duck Chess
requested_games.notes: ALLVARS required. A turn is a compound chess move plus mandatory duck relocation; no check, king capture, stalemated side wins. Test compound move notation and end-of-turn semantics.

requested_games.name: Torpedo Chess
requested_games.notes: Pawns may double-step from any eligible rank; en passant must work after such steps anywhere on board.

requested_games.name: Sideways Pawns
requested_games.notes: Sideways pawn movement is non-capturing; ordinary diagonal captures and pawn special rules remain.

requested_games.name: Capture Anything
requested_games.notes: Friendly captures need move generation, make/unmake, hash and royal-safety changes. FSF capture means mandatory captures, not Capture Anything.

requested_games.name: Fog of War
requested_games.notes: Needs observation-only input and belief-state search. No-check king capture alone does not implement hidden information. Hidden opponent pieces must never be accessible to the playing search.

requested_games.name: Spell Chess
requested_games.notes: Requires per-player spell stock/cooldown, freeze/jump state, compound actions, and adjudication. No built-in parity is claimed.

requested_games.name: Bughouse
requested_games.notes: FSF has a local-board rules/search adapter (twoBoards); a complete game needs synchronized partner pockets, clocks, transfers, terminal rules and a coordinator.

requested_games.name: 4-Player Chess
requested_games.notes: Four colors and turn order plus 14x14 cross geometry exceed the two-color 12x10 core; Teams and FFA require separate utility and adjudication.

requested_games.name: Team Chess (4PC Teams)
requested_games.notes: Partner across board, no partner captures, promotion rank 11, team win at opponent checkmate on their turn. Requires four-player team search.

requested_games.name: Free-for-All Chess (4PC FFA)
requested_games.notes: Point-scored four-player game with eliminations, inactive pieces and rank-8 promotion. Two-player negamax is not an equivalent model.

requested_games.name: Chaturanga (Chess.com rules)
requested_games.notes: Official help says white king d1 and ferz e1; pinned FSF starts king e1. The terms article confirms stalemate is a loss; black placement, promotion and move-limit parity still need fixtures. Do not substitute Shatranj.

requested_games.name: Solo Chess (capture puzzle)
requested_games.notes: Single-player solver with same-color captures, at most two captures per piece, and king as final survivor. Distinct from 4PC Solo scoring.

requested_games.name: Standard Shogi
requested_games.notes: Pinned per-game promotion/drop/repetition rules exist. USI and edge-case tests are separate; tournament-specific entering-king rules are not universally certified.
